name: Gomukeshi-kun
source:
A loud communications device Genpaku gave to Kureha. A sensor inside it allows it to react when monsters are in the vicinity. When not in use, Gomukeshi-kun resumes its form as an ordinary eraser.

[Based on the [URL=http://www.twofive.co.jp/hotokenser/chara/gomukeshi.html]official website[/URL].]
